details.biography:
Nadia Hansell is a UK-based stunt performer of English, Italian, and Polish descent, who has been a Senior Stunt Performer registered with the British Stunt Register since January 2018. Before embarking on her stunt career, she studied Biology at the University of Nottingham. Before that, she excelled as an international gymnast and competed nationally in both trampolining and judo.

Among her many skills are fight choreography, basic firearms handling, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, judo, staff and sword-and-shield work, high falls (up to 20 m), stair falls, trampoline, basic horse riding, dance, gymnastics, wire work, parkour/free running, basic fire burns, and PADI Divemaster qualifications.

Hansell’s screen credits span both blockbuster films and high-profile television series. As a stunt performer, she has worked on major Marvel Cinematic Universe films including Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019), Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022), Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania (2023), The Marvels (2023), as well as the fantasy series The Rings of Power Season 2 (2025) and the musical fantasy Wicked (2024). In television, she has performed stunt work for series such as The Feed (2019), Britannia (2019), Killing Eve (2019), The Bay (2019), and The Worst Witch(2019). Additionally, she doubled for Maisie Williams in the television comedy-drama Two Weeks to Live (2020). She also served as a stunt double in Red Rose (2022) and The Beaker Girls (2021–2023).

Hansell has earned critical recognition as part of the stunt ensembles of several acclaimed productions. She received three Screen Actors Guild Award nominations in the category Outstanding Action Performance by a Stunt Ensemble in a Motion Picture—for her work in The Batman (2022), Wicked (2024), and Deadpool & Wolverine (2025).
